notes.title: 3rd Birthday Update: 3.0 IS HERE!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Long time no see!

We've been hard at work and busy creating and game devving our butts off with an extremely cool (but still secret) project! Unfortunately, that meant a little bit of a dry phase for EndCycle VS... but we are BACK!  
And we've got quite a bit of news for you!

[h1]More bang for your buck![/h1]

We're happy to announce a permanent pricing change to EndCycle VS! We're slashing the price down in all regions!

We believe that with the game now being a few years old, what it needs most is more players joining the fray. As such, we decided the best step we can make to do so is to decrease one of the biggest entry barriers: the price point of EndCycle VS. We believe that the new price is something everybody with even a fleeting interest in the game can afford and get sucked into the hours of content the game provides!

[h1]3.0 Update![/h1]

Alongside the price change, we also added tons of new content for you all to enjoy!

[h2]New Game Mode: Coins, Coins, Coins![/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/07aa4f23d23d7cd128e5c8789d6ad0651fba2f75.gif[/img]

In the brand-new "Coin Mode," your objective is to hit your enemies and collect as many coins as they drop! Be careful not to get hit, however, as you will drop a lot of coins that your opponents can pick up!

This exciting game mode is less competitive, but man, is it fun! We can't wait to try it out with all of you!

[h2]Not just 1 or 2 new VOCs, BUT 10 OF THEM![/h2]

Did anyone ask for these? YES, YOU DID!

We took all of the suggestions you guys threw our way in the [url=https://discord.gg/zS33UCb]Discord server[/url] and compiled them. Then we looked through how we could implement them with the purpose of filling out the holes within our roster of attacks. Now there's a bunch of new strategies you can try out with the following VOCs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/531d70c024c55e81849a5a926b7b7fdd7ffcaca8.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv1 Galvanize:[/b] Electricity hits a big area ahead, creating metal!  
The idea was to make metal panels more accessible! And since there have been no Level 1 Electric VOCs so far that manipulate the battlefield, we thought, why not make one?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/4b6094b6c7f2c92d45a20754c0b6ec93abf8b48f.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv1 Multinade:[/b] Throws a grenade that copies current panel!  
Pair up this attack with something like Galvanize to change up a bunch of panels at once! Should come in useful with control strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/8f84335bdcfc3b31332ad7bd1ebefabdcf5efa55.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv1 InstaGlue:[/b] Hurts self, but reduces Crush!  
The very first attack of the game that allows you to reduce your own Crush. Can't wait for you guys to break it, making us have to balance it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/ed7d8ecf883d77e282a57176468e8699bbbec06d.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv1 Prayer:[/b] Drops healing Halo, creating a Holy panel!  
The very first VOC that creates Holy panels on its own. We're excited to see these defensive panels see more play in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/cd63f705874f05306811967c21f22942159543b0.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv2 HeatSoul:[/b] Poisons self, but speeds you up!  
Also the very first of its kind: a non-ultra attack that grants you a faster speed. Not the "haste" status which speeds up your cooldowns, but instead makes you as a whole faster! This includes movement speed too, but also poison tick damage! Be careful with this one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/7def5dc4a1432693bb7400dc8b7e0c9d1e2c6c34.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv2 Chant:[/b] Prolongs buffs and shoots sound wave!  
Some of you might notice this attack being familiar! It's actually the same attack that the "Anthem" VOC spits out every few seconds! However, this time around, you can use it by yourself without having to rely on an object to stay alive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/0a05dadb102c5446dc5d8b52607720ea3469e5ae.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv2 Durandal:[/b] Drops powerful sword, creating a Holy panel!  
The second VOC that spawns Holy panels! Kind of a double-edged sword—on the one hand, it has incredible strength (the highest of all VOCs) if it lands, on the other hand, it can create Holy panels for yourself! Use it wisely...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/a8bd8ec7d23a9ba303c42942a591cee8b1eadedd.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv2 Cauterize:[/b] Heals you by removing debuffs!  
One of our Discord members kept requesting this attack, wanting to see it with all his might. Well, here it is! A simple debuff-cleaning attack, which also lets you heal up again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/2749f4dcf707fdb6dc9f5bc43247368ca09a770d.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv2 Plasmarise:[/b] Grants Float, then heals if on Metal panel!  
Another suggestion from our Discord! We're always happy to oblige when it comes to adding cool ideas from our fans to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/d381f13f0bf744bbf3a194f6d29fc12e579c2bc7.gif[/img]  
[b]Lv3 SnowMan:[/b] Creates buddy that retaliates with freezing snowballs!  
This one is a little bit of a throwback: the snowman is actually an asset from way back when EndCycle started as an RPG. We hope you enjoy this menacing and cute homage to EndCycle's roots!

Whoo-wee! That's a lot of new attacks. This bumps the game's totals to...  
# of Lv1 Attacks: 31  
# of Lv2 Attacks: 43  
# of Lv3 Attacks: 23  
# of Lv4 Attacks: 23 (+ 1 LvX)  
With a grand total of 126 attacks! This means there's a brand-new total of 5,808 combinations for you to try out! We just can't wait to see some of the strategies you'll find that these new combos enable!

[h2]Balanced VOCs... wait how many?[/h2]

9 VOCs received some well-needed balancing treatment! Let's dive directly into the changes:  
[list]  
[*] MOC Chipper: Crush 0 -> 10  
[*] MOC GreenPiece: Now throws seed instead of having to charge!  
[*] Lv1 SpikeTrap -> IronSpikes: Lays metal panel and impaling spikes!  
[*] Lv1 X-Flame -> Lv1 FlameLoop: Creates spinning flames around target!  
[*] Lv1 IceCrawl: Rebalanced and now shoots three icicles!  
[*] Lv2 BoulderDrop: Normal -> Nature element  
[*] Lv3 Froster: Increased speed by 30%, freeze duration 1.5s -> 1.8s  
[*] Lv3 PotatoBomb: Now explodes to all adjacent panels!  
[*] Lv3 FireGate: Now creates three fire gates  
[/list]

[h2]3rd Birthday Fan-Art by Tobias![/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/6f5b5d6cc3afd8069c789782617a84fbae75c756.jpg[/img]  
One of our fans, Tobias, made us this incredibly cute picture to promote the game's third birthday! We're very grateful and love seeing this rendition of the Noises!

[h2]That's all folks![/h2]

Once again, thank you everyone for your enduring support. If you like the game, please consider dropping a positive review on Steam. We really appreciate your words of feedback and will keep doing our best to make this game as good as possible. If you want to share more direct feedback, please feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/zS33UCb]join our Discord and share it with us![/url]

Until next time, have fun and don't End the Cycle!  
Gal & Daniel - 12B3 Games

notes.title: 2.9 Update!!! Improved Practice and FunTime mode + Huge balancing!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're back to regular updates for the game, which means there's a ton of new content for you all to look forward to! Let's get right into it!

[h2]Improved Fun Time mode[/h2]
Ever wanted to play online with no cooldowns? 100x the damage? Only 20% HP, or even 200%? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/fde2ef02c1505d007f76e9acd3f0642965bf1195.gif[/img]

Say less, we got you covered! You can now adjust these settings when playing the Fun Time mode both offline or online!

[h2]Practice Mode Options[/h2]
For those of you wanting to test all of the game's parameters, you can now adjust them when fighting in the standard Practice Battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/75ff04f536b5bf920a7c704f86c0452bd14f2c2f.gif[/img]

This should make testing your strategies easier than ever before!

[h2]Re-Balanced Attacks and Characters[/h2]
After our last tournament, we went all out on patching the game and it's strats. Here are a few highlights of the changes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/9627f2029dc2e62f0f0e0508f02325065e104fc3.png[/img]

Most objects now have their health reduced to 300. This should enable you to finally get rid of pesky road-blocks your opponent places to protect themselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/97dd13761ad83bce1b715d44b0dcb2bca8daa3c0.png[/img]

We adjusted Fin a little bit. With the powerful strategies displayed by our devoted fan Herkura, it was near impossible to make a dent in his overheal stall strat. Now you will notice that Fin has significantly slower Ultra gain and the Ultra does not refill his cooldowns any longer. Fin is still a powerful tank to be aware of, but now you should be able to deal with him before the time expires!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/63c3e46fcf4325e610c4c1208cb4764963c2a9e4.gif[/img]

New sand panels! They now slow down cooldowns and entities standing on top of them! This should encourage their use a little more, as they are definitely a stronger presence to be aware of!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
Here's all the changes as a list:
[list]
+ New developer-side debug tools for easier desync detection!
+ Reworked Sand Panels: Entities standing on them are now slowed down!
+ Practice mode improvements: Damage tracker, settings to change the battle field panels or adapt practice dummy!
+ Brand new Funtime mode: Modify base HP,  Damage OR EVEN COOLDOWNS!
* Fixed AI enemies using removed VOCs and styles
* Neutral Panel party revert duration 16 -> 14 seconds
* Enemy Panel party revert duration 8 -> 4 seconds
* Reduced Move panel duration from 20 -> 10 seconds
* VOCs:
[list]
	*   Lv1 Companion: Reduced Health from 500 to 300
	*   Lv2 Panic: Element Normal -> Fire
	*   Lv3 Snacker: Element Normal -> Nature
	*   Lv1 ShotCorn: Damage 60 -> 40, crush 6% -> 7%; Explosion damage 160 -> 120, crush 20% -> 15%
	*   Lv1 LifeHook: Removed being able to pull heals out of objects
	*   Lv2 Mosquito: Reduced range
	*   Lv2 IceCube: Reduced Health from 600 to 300
	*   Lv3 Anthem: Reduced Health from 350 to 300, removed stun
	*   Lv4 Generator: Reduced Health from 400 to 300
	*   Lv4 Bomboyage: Reduced Health from 500 to 300
[/list]* Characters:
[list]
	*   Fin: Reduced Hyperactive speed buff from 35% to 20%; Reduced Ultra gain from getting crushed / damaged; Removed Ultra VOC refilling gauges
	*   Fossil Fuel: Ultra now falls slower
	*   Tri-Wing: Increased Fuel system recharge speed 6 -> 5 seconds
[/list]* Styles:
[list]
	*   Lv0 Flip: Now decreases VOC Power/Healing by 25% and increases crush by 25%
	*   Tempo Lv0 -> Lv1
	*   Impact Lv0 -> Lv1
	*   Lv1 Float: Reduced duration 6 -> 5 seconds
	*   Lv1 Magnet: Increased duration 2 -> 2.5 seconds
	*   Lv1 Repel: Increased duration 2 -> 4 seconds
[/list]
[/list]

We're so thankful for your continued support and can't wait to bring you more updates in the near future!

Stay tuned!
Gal Axis & Daniel Dorner - 12B3 Games

notes.title: SEPTEMBER UPDATE: New Panels, a lot of balancing and... X-VOCs???
notes.content:
[h1]We're back from Gamescom y'all![/h1]

And we're super excited to jump back into VS updates - especially with our September Tournament coming up this weekend!

Speaking of which: [url=https://challonge.com/tournaments/signup/QMLSfZ4JcU#/signup/alh742dions]You can register for the tournament here
[/url]

And we'll also be streaming the entire thing over on Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/12b3game] right here (click me)[/url]

With this update we're introducing two exciting new additions to your arsenal!

[h2][b]NEW PANEL TYPE[/b]: [b][u]HOLY[/u][/b]⭐[/h2]

For the first time since launch we're introducing a new panel type:
Holy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/a53d42e6b35b984e9785c2267ad0bacf9c762038.gif[/img]

While standing on this panel you will take 25% less damage from enemy attacks, making for a great way to boost your defensive packs!

[h2][b]NEW VOC[/b]: [b][u]LAST HOPE[/u][/b]🧟[/h2]

You're on your last leg, the opponent clearly has the upper hand and you see no way out?
Then it's time for LAST HOPE our very first LVL X Type VOC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/323b900cab248542a623622f234e39ff7e475e95.gif[/img]

Using this VOC immediately puts you into an "Determination" state for 6 seconds - re-filling all your VOCs and granting you one last chance at victory. Botch this chance though and... you lose.
USE THIS VOC WITH CAUTION!

With that all that's left are the many balancing changes we've included after seeing your tier lists and shoveling through your feedback! 

If you've got any changes you'd like to see, or if you've discovered VOC/Characters/Styles that need some balancing let us know in our Discord: https://discord.gg/zS33UCb

Check out the Changelog below, and we'll hear each other soon!
-Daniel and Gal

+ New Panel Type: "Holy"
    + Standing on this tile reduces damage taken by 25%
* Fixed Audio output device not switching when disconnecting or changing
* VOCs:
    * Lv1 Senpai: Removed Repel status effect
    * Lv1 Panic: Now increases own Crush gauge
    * Lv2 Mosquito Now auto-tracks enemies

    * Lv3 Companion -> Lv1

    + LvX Last Hope: Refills all VOC cooldowns and enters Determination state
* Styles:
    * Lv1 Grass/Metal/Lava -> Lv0
    * Lv1 Ninja -> Lv0
    * Lv1 Invis: Invisibility now lasts longer
    * Lv1 SuperArmor: Now blocks Stun, Freeze and Flinching
    * Lv1 Eject: Now removes all target Buffs
    * Lv1 Guard: Increased duration
    * Lv1 Invert: Now also flips VOC used

notes.title: Santa may be coming, but EndCycle VS 2.3 is already here!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Holiday season everyone![/h1]

[h2]The year is almost over so what better way to close it off than with our [u][b]last[/b][/u] VOC-Pass entries! The VOC-Pass was our gift to our loyal fans and something of a challenge to Gal and myself - we promised you 2 updates and at least 4 new VOCs  per month, and I'm proud to say that we've achieved just that!

With EndCycle VS 2.3 we've released 4 updates, 2 new Styles and 9 exciting new VOCs since the beginning of the Pass back in October! Try to top that Santa![/h2]

2.3 is our farewell update to the VOC Pass but we'll of course still update EndCycle VS regularly especially after our December tournament! We made sure to make this the best update yet so you'll have a lot to play with before our next update drops!

Let's get to it 🎄

[h2]VOCS[/h2]

[h3]🍿 SNACKER 🍿[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/37c3ac0e734485529b16faf06d55de8a440481c0.gif[/img]

Who doesn't love a good turret?
With this devious addition to your arsenal you'll spawn a SNACKER-object which keeps firing until its HP run out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/f78a15cdb6c1a4f30a97a1fe3996f483a97f511c.png[/img]

[b]Here's a fun idea for ya:[/b]

Flip the SNACKER to give yourself several HP boosts!
This stacks really well with Fins new ability "Hyperactive"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/dd87a4f149d0ef0ed5a3715d2ffbd2e4ed6eedf2.gif[/img]

🧲 [h3]MAGNADE [/h3]🧲

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/d0681e9a7bcd18a997204165f0f1d085d9703659.gif[/img]

Is your opponent playing too many objects for your taste?
Make them your enemies downfall with MAGNADE!
Magnade gives your opponent the MAGNET ailment which attracts all objects around them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/6a3e368efe9399bf3124b1e3d40b8c5465077930.png[/img]

[b]Pro tip:[/b]

Use Magnade to give misplaced cubes a second chance at glory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/be883e8ee39e8102f4df7054d29072316262a4f4.gif[/img]

[h2]STYLES[/h2]

[h3]🧲MAGNET🧲[/h3]

This Style grants the targeted entity the "MAGNET" ailment!
Use this to your advantage - take your turret on the go for instance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/537d62a06e11c2ad44d11bd7d8a7a9b712a2442c.gif[/img]

[h3]👊REPEL👊
[/h3]

This Style grants the targeted entity the "REPEL" ailment!
Push away unwanted entities and objects!
"SENPAI" now grants you this ailment automatically!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/a12b79a81a756a55bfacad1f719d36f2fb1c29dc.gif[/img]

[h2]CHARAKTERS[/h2]

[b]Several charakters have received new abilities and/or have gotten their abilities revised!
[u]This will make for some interactions during our next tournament on December 11th[/u][/b]

[h3]YVEN[/h3]

Yvens ultra is now much easier to land! 
His shards now attach themselves to himself instead of the entity he hits! 
This makes it much easier to put the desired effect on his Ultra-VOC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/cd3569841e34e055972e9fc1dc1bfd1e4237b103.gif[/img]

Additionally we gave him the "Overheal" ability so stacking up green shards really pays off now!
Wait a second... Overheal? Isn't that Fins ability?

[h3]FIN[/h3]

[b]Fin has evolved as a fighter! 
Our favorite healing specialist learned a new ability which compliments his already fanastic tanky build:
[b][u]HYPERACTIVE[/u][/b]![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/bb80f90b714135ea1a3d05ed2c64ed8eec2ab6bd.gif[/img]

With this new ability every time Fin get's healed by a VOC he receives a short speed boost!
So far so good! Wait that reminds me...

[h3]SOFA SOGOOD[/h3]

Sofas backstabbing ability had to go. 
How often were you able to attck your enemies from the back anyway?
We replaced with something better!
RISER let's the popular furniture Noise float above any potential ground-floor danger! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/dde3452872ad55c007c77493e73057e18c33c98a.gif[/img]

After using a VOC Sofa will gain the "Float" ailment for a couple of seconds!

[h2]CHANGELOG[/h2]

Here is the entire Changelog with all the juicy details you can expect from this update!

+ Added Magnet and Repel status ailments
    + Magnet: Pulls in objects towards entity for a short period of time!
    + Repel: Pushes away objects from entity for a short period of time!
* Countering now only makes you invincible towards the entity that triggered the counter
* Spectating in lobbies is now the default setting and can only be turned off by lobby host
* Adjusted UI in online lobby screens
* Characters:
    * Tankitty: Ultra VOC decreased stun duration
    * Fin: Added "Hyperactive" skill! Speeds you up when healing!
    * Sofa Sogood: Changed skill from Backstab to "Riser"!
        * Makes user float shortly after using a VOC!
    * Yven:
        + Added Overheal skill to Yven
        * Reworked Ultra VOC and Crystal Shard granting skill
        * Shards are now granted on Yven after using an attack
        * Spawned Crystal now grants different effects based on shards currently on Yven
* VOCs:
    + Lv3 Snacker: Spawns popcorn machine which keeps firing at enemy!
    * Lv2 ElecNade -> Magnade: Throws magnetizing and stunning grenade!
    * Lv4 Cybarrier: Reduced duration 6s -> 5s
    * Lv2 Virus: Poison duration 8s -> 6s
    * Lv1 Senpai: Now grants Repel effect
    * Lv3 MineCake, Lv1 SpikeTrap now do not affect floating entities
    - Removed Lv3 AdvanceRush
* Style:
    * Lv0 Counter: Changed some interactions
        * Lv4 Counter-Cybarrier: Increases duration not hits
        * Lv3 Counter-PanelGrab: Takes over 3 panels in front
        * Lv4 Counter-AreaGrab: Takes over a row and a panel in front
        * Lv4 Counter-Neutralize: Neutralizes over a row and a panel
    * Lv0 Treasure: Counter attacks now automatically trigger once treasure activates the VOC

[h2]TOURNAMENT[/h2]

With all the VOC-Pass updates having been released it is time to prove your mastery over all the new VOCs and abilities!

OUR DECEMBER TOURNAMENT WILL TAKE PLACE ON DECEMBER 11th 7PM CET!

You can sign up for free [url=https://challonge.com/tournaments/signup/Mu6x2EnjDw#/signup/6ka4xr7fs6p]here[/url].
[u][b]
Have a wonderful Holiday Season everyone and we'll see each other at the tournament!
Love,
Daniel and Gal - 12B3 Games
[/b][/u]

notes.title: Modding Jam! Join and create your own memes inside EndCycle VS!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to another EndCycle VS Modding Jam!

What is a modding jam? Well...

[b]"You can create your own attacks, characters and more all without a single line of code using the in-game Toolbox!"[/b]

[u]Your task is to create the funniest EndCycle VS Meme Mod possible in under 2 weeks![/u]

[b]First time creating custom mods and content in EndCycle using the toolbox?[/b]
No problem! There is an in-game tutorial on how to do so which you can start by simply opening the toolbox in the Mods menu (or pressing F1)!

[h1]The theme is: MEMES[/h1]
Low-quality shitpost? A character consisting of only one sprite? Game-breaking VOC that only people from the EndCycle discord will understand?

If you can name it, you can meme it! Create a mod full of memes within the next two weeks and upload it on the Itch.IO page here: [url=https://itch.io/jam/323168/preview]https://itch.io/jam/323168/preview[/url]

You can submit your mod for the jam from the 7th July 19:00 GMT, to the 24th July 16:00 GMT!

Are you seeking help or a team? [url=https://discord.gg/zS33UCb]Join our discord![/url]

[h2]Rules / Guidelines:[/h2][list]
[*] You can work alone or in a team!
[*] If you don’t own the game you can still participate as part of a team!
[*] Submit your mod with a short description in a file, where you'll detail your mod.
[*] No NSFW mods, submitting mods with NSFW content will lead to an automatic disqualification
[*] Pre-existing assets need to be credited inside a text file submitted alongside the game mod
[*] Mods created before the start date cannot be used
[*] Please submit a 30+ second video clip or trailer of your mod alongside it!
[/list]

[h2]Ranking[/h2]
After the deadline is over, we will be going through all the mods and playing them!
The final ranking is based on:[list]
[*] Overall: How was the mod? Was there a lot of content? Was it fun to play?
[*] Creativity: Does the mod add something completely new to the game? Do the creations go beyond what is thought possible with the toolbox?
[*] Quality: This does not refer to whether it was a high-quality or low-quality shitpost, but rather how much care went into creating it!
[/list]

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
The creators of the top 3 mods will each receive an EndCycle VS Steam code to gift to a friend! Additionally, all the mods will be showcased on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjvyz4uEfbeAJNZCWhJHPlA]official 12B3 Games Youtube Channel[/url]!

We will also be playing through all submissions in a special stream, on Sunday 24th July!


We're looking forward to you all joining and creating funny mods with us!
See you all online!
- Gal & Daniel

notes.title: Huge Update! New character, VOCs, Ultras, Styles and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]

We hope that you're having a great weekend!
Today is the day! Our first major update ever since the end of Early Access has arrived!

Let's get straight to it!

[h2] Introducing... [u][b]YVEN[/b][/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/c22285562859400337295c1728f3cc3e85f66060.jpg[/img]

Yven is the second in command at Azure Shield. Del's right hand man and what many see as the strongest man in Anikka. Shrouded in mystery his abilities heavily differ from any other power previously seen in this world. His mighty crystals serve only one purpose: 
[u][b]Let Del re-awaken the Godi in order to destroy them for good.[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/fffa6d3a5e54fdd783123f8439ca93b0077cac1b.gif[/img]
His ability and his ultra VOC work together in tandem. 
Yvens ability lets him carry 3 shards with him that he shares with any entity that gets hit by one of his attacks.

His Ultra VOC spawns a crystal that affects anyone carrying these shards - depending on the number of shards the effect gets stronger or weaker.

The effect of the crystal is determined by the last VOC-Type Yven used.
[h3][b][u]Control[/u]:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/0d03b4aa0416477d45f848db29fa5af96fabe3bf.gif[/img]

[h3][b][u]Effect[/u]:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/d1a03dad37831d291acd0cb0da8ebb5017f23fa4.gif[/img]

[h3][b][u]Guard[/u]:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/d18b9105eedaf8908df6f8a8246af12cd034dc84.gif[/img]

[b]Gigantree[/b] and [b]Inksplash[/b] are here to shake up the game!

Gigantree creates grass panels around itself through an unshakeable and unmovable tree, while Inksplash is a new way to blind your enemies and deal damage to them at the same time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/aa7c5acda47b805e3f681c0a19c8550a2557f877.gif[/img]

[h2][u][b]7 New Styles!![/b][/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/b69762c003f62f39574379af79fd7cdd67f7dc26.gif[/img]

With the "[u]Ninja[/u]" Style you switch places with an entity on the field and let it use your VOC for you!

We can't wait to see how you will use these VOCs in the future!

[list]
[b][*] Punk
[*] QT
[*] Greed
[*] Cherry
[*] Jeremy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33943511/e3cdf5b7b25c0e36ff8a0b5a8e106ea3890846a7.gif[/img]

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Update: How far we are and general progress?
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gal Axis here! I am the project lead and programmer of EndCycle VS!

I just created a little update vlog on the state of the online multiplayer of the game here:
[previewyoutube=uJh8uZEpVDI;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is the content of the video in text form if you would rather read:

As you might know, we have been reworking the online multiplayer systems of the game since early January. As such, the official servers have been offline a lot of the time.
[b]We apologize for this inconvenience.[/b] We are working diligently and as fast as we can on bringing out the new multiplayer experience.

[u]So the question on your minds must be how the new online multiplayer is coming along.[/u]

After looking at the systems in place, I decided to keep the lobby system intact as it worked well until now.

On the flipside however, I have started a complete rework of the old online battle code.
Before the rework, it was extremely hard to maintain and it took a lot of resources to adapt it to changes and additions to the game, such as the ultra attacks.
I have now made it possible for the battles to automatically transfer their entirety over the network and load it with barely any adaptations to the netcode to work.
This change also makes it possible for modded battles to work online. However, this ended up being a mistake, as battles would perform very poorly in terms of FPS and the amount of data transferred.

At the beginning my goal was to make the systems so automatized that it would need no further input from me or developers of mods to create online multiplayer content. Unfortunately, while I was testing these systems, it became apparent that complete automation was not possible. In a battle run situation, the game simply transferred too much data and ran very slowly trying to copy the state of all objects to the clients. I exhausted almost every possible optimization measure possible while still keeping it all automated. I kept insisting on this solution so that developers of mods would have an easy life, however it ended up costing me a lot of development time.

I have now decided to rework this automatic systems and introduce some manual networking definitions that modders will also have to use in order to keep the data transfer low and the FPS high! What this means, is that I now need another go at reworking the online multiplayer to transfer events instead of the data itself! This change will minimize the amount of data transfer and make it not impact the performance of the game. This change is quite the big amount of work, so it will take some more time before the new online multiplayer is ready to be played.

I hope you now have a clearer grasp at where the online multiplayer update is and hope you look forward to playing it.

Thank you all for your continued support of the game! Look forward to more news about the release date of this update soon!

notes.title: The Future Of EndCycle VS
notes.content:

EndCycle VS has always been a passion project of mine, that I had the joy of being able to pursue professionally since we released it on Steam in Early Access.

I want to take a moment and thank you all for your support so far. Your kind steam reviews, discord messages and tweets have meant the world to me and the team. Seeing how much you all love our work has been shocking in the best kind of way to say the least. <3

Now let's get into the meat of things: If I had to say, the secret dev-version of the project is just about 95% complete! If you are not up-to-speed with all the new additions, I recommend you look through [url=https://twitter.com/EndCycleGame]our twitter [/url]and check our most-recent posts for a recap of things that will be added with the next update! This time around we added two new VOCs: PanelBack and AreaForce! The former reverts back an enemy panel in front of you and shoots a powerful energy orb towards your enemy! The latter forcefully takes back the closest row from your enemy and is only level 3, but it hurts you slightly in exchange!

notes.title: Crimson Update!
notes.content:
What. It. Do. EndCycle Fans.

We're excited to bring you another big update! To try it out, simply switch to the beta branch, by right-clicking the game in your steam inventory, and pressing properties. From there, simply select the beta option as shown here:[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33943511/6a6564ded11edb11dce322d91a4eeeead3e697c2.png[/img]


The focus this time lies on bringing you more tools and attacks to make battles even more exciting than before!
    
Let's first talk about all the new ailments that are possible with this update:

        + Blind: Limits your vision to a 3x3 area
        + Haste: Speeds up your VOC cooldown speed
        + Brake: Slows down your VOC cooldown speed
        + Berserk: Boosts your attack power for a small duration
        + Meak: Reduces your attack power for a small duration
        + Floating: Makes you float, making you unaffected by panels
        + Frozen: Freezes you into place, making you unable to move

Now unto the VOCs that utilize those ailments and more:

        + Lv3 BackFlash - Counters with blinding attack!
        + Lv3 Companion - Places cube that slides towards attacker!
        + Lv2 BoulderBack - Counter by dropping a boulder on enemy!
        + Lv2 Virus - Counters with poisonous explosion when hit!
        + Lv2 CoffeeBean - Throws bean that speeds up cooldowns!
        + Lv2 PanelLance - Hits 2x1 area with panel changing slash!
        + Lv2 ShowStopper - Slows down enemy gauge when hit!
        + Lv3 FrontFlare - Blinds 3 panels ahead!
        + Lv1 SpikeTrap - Lays spikes that impale enemy!

        * Froster and Humidity now freeze enemies
        * Caffeine now grants haste
        * Reworked StunWave and ToxicWave
        * Reworked Anthem and Lightmass
    
Of course there are a bunch of new Styles as well:

        + Lv1 Meek - Weakens target attacks!
        + Lv1 Float - Makes target float, ignoring panels!
        + Lv1 Haste - Speeds up target cooldowns!
        + Lv1 Brake - Slows down target cooldowns!
        + Lv1 Blind - Turns target blind!
        + Lv1 Freeze - Target is frozen, preventing movement!
        + Lv1 Crack - Target's panel is cracked!
        + Lv1 Repair - Target's panel is repaired!
        + Lv1 Grass - Target's panel is changed to grass!
        + Lv1 Ice - Target's panel is changed to ice!
        + Lv1 Metal - Target's panel is changed to metal!
        - Removed Heal-2, Heal-3, Power- and Crush-Styles!
        * All Styles are now either Lv0 or Lv1, and many styles have been re-balanced!
        
Your mods can now be even more extensive:

        + Styles are now moddable - which means that you can create your own styles now!
        + Volatile Skill: Keeps draining HP
        + SuperArmor Skill: Prevents flinching during attacks
        + Rebound Attack now can have a custom drawable
        + Shoot Attacks can now travel tile-by-tile
        * Updated UI with more colors to be more readable

    > Other improvements:
       + All backgrounds now have custom panels
       + New background: Astrat Night
       + Replays of past-battles can now be watched in the Replay mode
       + Added automatic battle replay recording
       + Added indicator when getting hit by weakness element
       + Added Cheat and Debug settings
       + Battles can now be set to best of three, or best of five
       * Rebalanced Characters
       * Improved VOC UI feel
       * Unlock Message is now faster
       * Added Reset Settings button

And that's all for this update, but the next one is just around the corner.
In fact, this update is just the first half of the huge Crimson-Update, which was getting bigger and bigger the longer we worked on it. 
We decided it was getting too big for a single update and didn't want to keep you waiting any longer for a lot of stuff we could just bring you early.

The next update will bring you 3 new campaigns, which further explore the world of Anikka. One of those revolves around Cress - the brave leader of Crimson Force, while another one is about Del - the calculating chief of Azure Shield! As for the third one... You'll just have to wait and see!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33943511/e9fce0fd81162d5a9457a860dfacea71ef7039aa.jpg[/img]

We can't wait for you to see it.
Until next time!

- Daniel and Gal

Once we are finished with this update, we'll let you know about the bigger things to come. We can't wait to see what you'll do with the modding tools!

notes.title: March Toolbox Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hello lovely Cyclists![/b]

With this new update we're introducing you to ONE NEW BACKGROUND!
...but more importantly we've updated the in-game modding tools now allowing you to modify EndCycle VS to a greater extent!

What is also new, is that you can stack up multiple mods at once, and integrate up to 1000 of your own characters into the game!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33943511/a2edf494ad5e371688b3e4f3cacfab797b2050bc.png[/img]

If you haven't gotten into modding yet here is what you can do in EndCycle VS:
[list]
[*] Add new playable characters (sprite, stats & abilities) to the Roster
[*] Create your own battlefields 
[*] Create enemies and define their AI however you want
[*] You can of course create you own background as well
[*] Add your music to fights
[*] Change the sound effects of the game
[*] Heck if you want to you can change any sprite so you can even remove our beautiful logo
[*] Use [i]every possible variable[/i] to create unique attacks
[/list]
Here's some ideas of what you can do with these variables:
[list]
[*] Change the attack range and trajectory!
[*] Chain multiple individual attacks together to form a combo!!
[*] Make the attack transform and interact with the battlefield!
[*] Add custom sound effects!
[*] Change its element, power and level!
[*] And much much more!
[/list]
[b]And all of the modding can be done through the toolbox UI! No coding necessary![/b]


On the content side of things, here are some extra things we included with this update:
[list]
[*] "On Sale" tab in shop
[*] Power/Crush display when looking at VOCs
[*] New VOC icons
[*] Overhauled shop UI
[/list]

We'll be posting more posts and tutorials on how to mod the game very soon, so stay tuned!
